reason: I'd download it for the free first summary before my appointment, and logging plus the basic doctor PDF are free forever, so there's nothing I'd need to pay for. I don't pay for apps, and I'd cancel any trial before it charged me.
objection: Predictions never work for my irregular cycles, so 'honest ranges' will probably just be so wide they're useless. And the free tier already covers what I'd actually use.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor actually changed something because of the free summary, I might pay the $7.99 one-time for the next appointment. I'd never do a subscription.
